generate_commandlines_from_metadata: generate commandlines to process all metadata.json files found recursively in an input directory
run_generate_from_metadata_files: run the script with --input_dir and --output_dir to print commandlines for generating image pairs
run_with_prefix: run the script with a --prefix argument to prepend environment setup commands to each generated commandline
skip_existing_metadata: skip scenes where the output metadata.json file already exists to avoid reprocessing
batch_generate_image_pairs: batch generate commandlines for creating image pairs from Habitat-Sim metadata files across multiple scenes
